reader.requirement: At --std 85 a MERGE is refused when any two of its file-names (file-name-1 the SD included) are named in one SAME AREA, SAME SORT AREA or SAME SORT-MERGE AREA clause, or when a SAME RECORD AREA clause names two of its files of which any is not a GIVING file; two GIVING files may share a SAME RECORD AREA.

edition-consulted.switches: held1985 (Edition.Year < 2002) gates only the SORT GIVING-in-SAME-RECORD-AREA arm (1985 SORT SR9); every MERGE arm (SortMergeArea, Area when merge, RecordArea when merge) ignores it

reader.edition-search: grep of Edition.Edition / DialectLevel / DialectBehaviors / Constructs in SortBinder.cs and FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs (only line 656, report files in SAME below 2002, not this rule)
